source.author: verg
source.text: Una in praecelsa consedit rupe Celaeno, infelix vates, rumpitque hanc pectore vocem:
source.text_original: Una in praecelsa consedit rupe Celaeno, / infelix vates, rumpitque hanc pectore vocem: /
source.text_english: On a lofty rock Celaeno sat apart, the ill-omened prophetess, and broke forth with this cry from her heart:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: an meritos fas est mihi rumpere questus?
reuse.text_original: an meritos fas est mihi rumpere questus?
reuse.text_english: Or is it right for me to break off my deserved complaints?
